---
name: 💡 Feature Request / Proposal
about: Suggest an idea or architectural improvement for OpenBoard
title: '[FEAT] '
labels: ['enhancement', 'triage']
assignees: ''
---

### Is your feature request related to a problem?
A clear and concise description of what the problem or limitation is (e.g., *I'm always frustrated when...*).

### Describe the Solution You'd Like
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen, including any UI/UX or MCP tool interface suggestions.

### Proposed Architectural / Code Changes (Optional)
If you have technical thoughts on how to implement this across the monorepo (`packages/core`, `packages/mcp`, `apps/web`, `cli`, etc.), describe them here.

### Describe Alternatives You've Considered
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions, tools, or workarounds you've considered.

### Additional Context
Add any other context, mockup screenshots, or diagrams about the feature request here.
